idea-plugin.name: CRA 24/72/14 Reporting Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your SECURITY.md against the EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting clock that started on 11 September 2026 — 24 hours, 72 hours, 14 days, to ENISA and your coordinating CSIRT.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → CRA 24/72/14 Reporting Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cra-24-72-14-reporting-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cra-24-72-14-reporting-lint

action.text: CRA 24/72/14 Reporting Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run CRA 24/72/14 Reporting Lint on the file in the editor
